new_insert_email_body.title: London conference coordination
new_insert_email_body.text:
Hi Emma,

I'm coordinating logistics for the London conference and need to know which cities you'll be in from May 15 through May 30. Please send your list of travel cities for that period to mark.black-2134@gmail.com with the subject 'Travel Cities' so I can align accommodation across stops.

Thanks,
Mark
